newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Monday amid select buying by spinners, but prices are likely to fall amid rising new crop arrivals, dealers said.
"The supply is rising but selective buying by some major spinning mills of the Punjab province has helped keep prices steady," one said.
In the kerb market NIAB-78 traded at 2,150 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
